verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only a human search portal. One note says states may offer 'structured information' for retrieval as a non-binding service, but no OpenAPI spec, XML schema, or data dictionary for any machine channel is published or referenced. The probe found no llms.txt docs index either. The axis applies to a public register, so absence of evidence yields none.
